<h1 class="csf-hero__title">We make dessert.<br>Without a <em>kitchen</em>.</h1>

<p class="csf-hero__lede">
<strong>Cuochi senza fuochi means cooks without fires.</strong> We get a group together in
Padova and make desserts and easy recipes on the spot: no oven, no hob, nothing that
needs a real kitchen. The ingredients are waiting when you arrive. You learn something
you can make again in your own room, and then everybody eats it.
</p>

::: {.csf-section}
<p class="csf-section__kicker">Start to finish</p>
<h2 class="csf-section__title">What actually happens</h2>
<p class="csf-section__sub">Four steps, with nothing hidden between them. This is the whole format.</p>

::: {.csf-steps}
- ### You say you're coming
  One message on Instagram, TikTok or YouTube. We send back the address, the time,
  and what we're making.

- ### You turn up empty handed
  This is the part people get wrong. You do not cook anything beforehand and you do
  not bring a dish. Everything is already on the table when you walk in.

- ### We make it together
  Someone talks the group through a recipe that needs no oven and no hob. Salame di
  cioccolato, tiramisù, a no bake cheesecake. You do the mixing, the crushing and the
  rolling, standing up, talking to whoever is next to you.

- ### Then we eat it
  It goes in the fridge, we wait, we eat the whole thing. You leave knowing a recipe
  you can repeat in a room with no kitchen, and knowing the people you made it with.
:::
:::

::: {.csf-section}
<p class="csf-section__kicker">Why it works</p>
<h2 class="csf-section__title">Three things that make it different</h2>

::: {.csf-grid}
::: {.csf-card}
<span class="csf-card__icon"><i class="bi bi-fire"></i></span>

### Senza fuochi, without fires
The name is the promise. Student rooms come with two hobs that half work, no oven,
and a fridge shared between five people. Every recipe we make is built for exactly
that, so nobody is ever excluded by their kitchen.
:::

::: {.csf-card}
<span class="csf-card__icon"><i class="bi bi-piggy-bank"></i></span>

### Cheaper than one drink
Taking part costs you nothing. Meeting people in this city usually means a bar tab
or a club entry, every single time. This is the version you can afford every month.
:::

::: {.csf-card}
<span class="csf-card__icon"><i class="bi bi-wifi-off"></i></span>

### Offline, on purpose
No app, no swiping, no feed. Fifteen people, one table, phones face down and your
hands covered in crushed biscuit. It turns out that talking is easier when you are
both busy doing something else.
:::
:::
:::

::: {.csf-quote}
Housing is solvable. **Loneliness is the expensive part.**

<cite>the idea behind Cuochi senza fuochi, March 2022</cite>
:::

::: {.csf-section}
<p class="csf-section__kicker">Why we bother</p>
<h2 class="csf-section__title">You can rent a room. You cannot rent the people.</h2>

<p class="csf-section__sub">
When you move somewhere new, you sort out a room and a commute within weeks. Those
two things guarantee the financial capital. Human capital is the one nobody hands you
a contract for, and working or studying full time leaves very little room to build it.
</p>

Cuochi senza fuochi exists because the usual alternatives don't work for everyone.
Bars cost money every single time. Clubs are loud and you meet no one. Apps put you
back on a screen. Standing around a table making a dessert costs nothing, and it puts
you in a room with people who live ten minutes away: the ones you can actually keep seeing.

## Next session: just turn up

You don't need to know anyone. You don't need to cook. You don't need to bring
anything. Most people at their first Cuochi senza fuochi came on their own, and
that is the normal way to arrive.
